chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Marable's band on the St. Paul versus Buffano's on the J.S.
summary: Marable's band was on the St. Paul and Jules Buffano's, with Wayne King, on the J.S. The Streckfus brothers sent the society crowd to the J.S. and the ordinary crowd to the St. Paul.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Now, he would have had one of the best, I mean, bands around on that boat.
Yes, I think so, yeah. He was a real great band, see, because they had that fine band, Jules Buffano. He was on the other boat, the J.S., which was --
Do you have any idea how to spell that?
Buffano. And Wayne King was playing hot clarinet and the first saxophone in that band?
He turned out to be the waltz king.
How extraordinary. Well, which boat were you on?
The other band, Jules Buffano, and them, they were on the JS. They have two boats, see, in St. Louis at the time. The JS, they got the society crowd, and the St. Paul got the ordinary --
JS. What did that stand for?
The brothers, those Strickles Brothers knew music.
That's why Fate's band was the finest band ever heard in your life.
